title: ControlSaturatedNotification
description: Params of the control.saturated server-to-client notification. A refused control request with no id has no response to carry the -32004 error, so the server emits this instead, rate-limited, carrying method class and scope only. Both fields are server vocabulary: methodClass is the coarse class of the refused method, scope the saturated admission's name. Neither is free text from the request.

methodClass.description: Coarse server-side class of the refused control method (e.g. ssh, session, fs). Never the raw method name.

scope.description: The saturated resource, named by the server: the admission's identity (control.Admission.Name). Closed server vocabulary, never request text.
